siteMetadata.name: Mauro Bernardini
siteMetadata.title: Mauro Bernardini - portfolio
siteMetadata.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Galaxy Formation based in Zurich, Switzerland 🇨🇭. 
    My research focuses on numerical simulations and visualization methods, Machine Learning applications and AI integration 
    for scientific analysis pipelines.
siteMetadata.about:
Hi there, I am an astrophysicist and data scientist by training with a passion for coding and everything AI-related.
    I love to explore new ways to visualize complex data sets and research results.
    Find out more through my CV above.
    When I am not working on projects, you will probably find me outdoors, training handstands or reading a good book.
    Feel free to reach out, whether it's serious business or just for a friendly hi!

projects.name: ember-1
projects.description: A research project where I deployed neural networks to emulate the most expensive part of hydrodynamical simulations of galaxy formation: baryons!           While ember-1 achieves similar accuracy, it is over 30,000 times faster compared to the full simulation.           Built with TensorFlow and Keras.

projects.name: ember-2
projects.description: The successor of ember-1, extending the framework to large simulation times and more emulated baryon channels.            Bigger, better, faster, and a little bit smarter too!            Built with PyTorch.

projects.name: punkt
projects.description: A python package to visualize simulation data. The package provides particle-to-grid operations using Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics.          Try it out, it's free and blazingly fast!          Built with C++, OpenMP and Python.
